title: Breaking of invariant curves: from the Fermi-Ulam map to the breathing circle billiard
summary: We consider the breathing circle billiard, in which a point particle moves freely inside a disk. The radius varies periodically in time, with elastic reflections at the moving boundary. In this system the angular momentum is preserved, and fixing its value $c$ reduces the dynamics to a two-dimensional exact symplectic map on a cylinder. In the high-energy regime this map is a twist map generated by a diagonally periodic generating function $h_c$.
